AGENTS.md — Development & Maintenance Guide

Source: AGENTS.md

Guidance for AI agents and developers working on the glass.sqdaitools R package. Follow these rules without exception.

Hard rules (MUST)

  1. Git operations belong to the maintainer. Never run git commit, git push, git tag, or any history-modifying command. Prepare changes, suggest commands in the reply, and let the maintainer (Dai Shaoqing) execute them.
  2. The two legacy scripts never enter the repository. glass_download_vi.R and glass_process.R are the maintainer’s local reference scripts. They are gitignored and must stay that way: never git add -f them, never copy their content into tracked files, never reference them in docs.
  3. No private filesystem paths. Tracked files must never contain machine-specific paths such as F:/..., C:/Users/..., D:/Program Files/... or anything under a personal backup tree. In examples and tests use relative paths or tempdir(). Before finishing a task, grep the files you touched for such patterns.
  4. output/ is local-only. Paper drafts, journal outlines, software- copyright (软著) materials and similar manuscripts live in output/ (gitignored). Never track, commit, or publish anything from it.
  5. Datasets are build artifacts. data/glass_products.rda and data/glass_tiles.rda are regenerated by the scripts in data-raw/. Never hand-edit data/*.rda; change the build scripts and re-run.

Project map

Path Role
R/ 11 source files, 13 exported functions (registry / tiles / DOY / list / download / self-scan fetch / process / shiny)
data-raw/ One-shot build scripts: crawl_archive.R → probe_samples.R → verify_bands.R → verify_batch.R (batch variant verification) → build_tiles.R → build_registry.R (network needed)
data/ Bundled datasets glass_products (133 variants, 131 verified across 4 layouts) and glass_tiles (648 tiles)
inst/shinyapp/app.R Adaptive one-viewport ROI download UI (bslib + leaflet), launched by glass_app(); roam/draw toggle, in-page directory browser (shinyFiles); thin shell over package functions
tests/testthat/ Offline unit tests (113 passing); network tests gated behind GLASS_SMOKE=1
vignettes/ glass-quickstart.Rmd (EN) and glass-quickstart-zh.Rmd (中文), network chunks eval=FALSE
_pkgdown.yml, docs/ pkgdown site config and built site (committed; GitHub Pages serves /docs on main)
dev/ Local dev assets: make_logo.R (hex logo), smoke_test.R, build notes; not shipped in the tarball
man/figures/logo.png Hex sticker, regenerated by dev/make_logo.R

Common commands (run from repo root)

# R executable used on this machine (Git Bash)
R=/c/Rlanguage/R-4.6.1/bin/Rscript.exe

$R -e 'devtools::document()'        # regenerate man/ + NAMESPACE after roxygen edits
$R -e 'devtools::test()'            # unit tests (add GLASS_SMOKE=1 for network tests)
$R dev/smoke_test.R                 # offline smoke; GLASS_SMOKE=1 adds end-to-end download
$R -e 'pkgdown::build_site()'       # rebuild docs/ (rerun after logo or doc changes)
# 本机注意:build_site 默认子进程偶发段错误(2026-11),失败时改用
# $R -e 'pkgdown::build_site(preview = FALSE, quiet = TRUE, new_process = FALSE)'

Full verification before any release: rebuild the tarball and run R CMD check (must stay 0 errors / 0 warnings). On this machine run R commands with env -u LC_CTYPE -u LC_ALL -u LANG to avoid the Git Bash locale leak that breaks child R processes.

Registry conventions

  • Variants are identified by variant_id (e.g. LAI_MODIS_250M).
  • verified = TRUE rows carry file-naming fragments (code, version, layer) and band metadata (fill_value, scale_factor, valid_min/max) measured from a real granule; only these feed glass_read() automatically.
  • Extending the registry = add the variant to data-raw/verify_batch.R (FAMILIES/TARGET_IDS) and rerun it, then build_registry.R; the batch writes data-raw/verified_overlay.csv which build_registry merges (CSV rows take precedence). Never edit the .rda by hand.
  • terra/GDAL already apply HDF SDS scale/offset on read; glass_read() converts the raw fill value to post-scale units before NA-ing it (see dev/README.md band-metadata notes).
  • cadence_days = NA 是诚实状态,不许手工补登记。 verify_batch.R 不测 合成周期;30+ 个 verified 变体(2026-11 实测:FVC 系、Albedo AVHRR/MIX/ 0.5D、Albedo_MODIS_0_5D、FAPAR/GPP/LAI/LST/NDVI/PAR/NPP 0.5D、RN、SM、 TPSCE、AWGF、LST_AVHRR_Daily-ODC…)为 NA。glass_fetch() 的 cadence-NA 目录自检分支(year-loop + 文件名复合码)是正解,不要往 verified_overlay.csv 或 build seed 里”补 cadence”。
  • 档案实测形态(自检分支覆盖面,未来变体先归到这几类):
    1. 复合文件直躺年份文件夹(年/A2018217.hdf,8 天/日均);
    2. 年下 6 位月码(.201001. = YYYYMM,如 NDVI 0.25°);
    3. 年下数字 DOY 子目录(2018/049/,如 Albedo MODIS 250M);
    4. 根下版本包装目录(0.5D/GLASS_NPP_0.5D_V40/,NPP),自检只下探一级;
    5. 地理 1° 分格 × 年度单文件(n045e120/HiGLASS_…_2018_v01_LAI.tif, HiGLASS LAI/FAPAR 20m;.glass_fetch_geotile() 按显式 tiles 或 ROI bbox 选格,根下分格 > 60 且无选格时不自动全量列举)。 另有纯静态集合(AGB/KGClim/Crops/Albedo ABI 气候态,layout = "flat", 日期不参与)。
  • 官网 download 卡片名 ↔︎ 登记表口径(D3LTool 对拍以此为准): HiGLASS_LAI 20m = LAI_HR_LAI_V01(卡片指 archive/LAI/HR_LAI,数据在 V01/ 一层);HR FAPAR 卡 = FAPAR_HR_FAPAR_V01;SRF 家族正确名称是 Surface Radiation Budget Component (SRF-j)(曾误标 “Snow-free Albedo Climatology”,2026-11 正名;官网第 20 节 Snow-free 气候态的真实文件在 Albedo/ABI/ 即 Albedo_ABI_* 变体);官网 LST 卡指向 LST/MODIS/Daily/1KM/,对应登记变体 LST_MODIS_Daily(url_root 已含 1KM/)。档案重排会让核验时的深层 url_root 过期:verify_batch 现已把 年层 URL 写进 overlay 的 url_root 列,配合 REFRESH=TRUE + TARGET_IDS 定点重验即可修复(见该脚本常量区)。
  • 命名空间卫生:包内 R 代码对 base-but-not-namespace 的函数一律限定 (utils::head、utils::data 等),否则 R CMD check 会挂 universal-formula NOTE(踩过 head 的坑)。

Cross-surface consistency (三面一致)

  • README.Rmd 是 README.md 的源头;改 README 一律改 .Rmd 再 knit, 不直接手编 README.md。
  • D3L Tool 的版本承诺以 README 文字为准(已对齐 v2.7.0); D3LTool 发新版时:改 README.Rmd → knit →(可选)app 徽章带版本 → pkgdown::build_site()。
  • pkgdown 的 docs/ 是构建产物且入库;description 版本、man 页更新后必须 重建站点,避免页脚版本徽章漂移。

Shiny app runtime conventions

  • glass_app() 跑的是安装版包;调试用 devtools::load_all(),改 app.R 后在原 R 会话里要重启 R 或 install() 再 glass_app()(命名空间缓存)。
  • UI 一律 bslib page_fillable 单屏自适应,不滚动;禁止原生 modal 对话框 (tcltk 模态会冻死 Shiny/RStudio Viewer 事件环,目录选择一律 shinyFiles 页面内弹窗)。
  • 外链跳转走 Shiny.setInputValue(..., {priority:'event'}) + 服务端 utils::browseURL(RStudio Viewer pane 会吞掉 target="_blank" 的新窗)。
  • 进度条只挂 on.exit(p$close(), add=TRUE),不再显式 close(双关闭警告)。
  • 预览选层(0.6.0):多 SDS/多图层文件由 .glass_preview_layers() 枚举; 多变量 SDS 读取走 terra::sds(f)[[i]](1 基;勿用 rast(subds=n) 的数组 索引语义,单变量 netCDF 会报 “array index out of range”);单变量 netCDF 无子数据集,describe(sds=TRUE) 直接报错,枚举回退时间层分支。注册表 fill/scale/valid_range 按变体主层测量,QC 类子层会被整层洗 NA, .glass_read_layer() 检测到全 NA 自动退回原始值读取。2–98% 分位拉伸 (对齐 geemap COG 默认)由 .glass_preview_domain() + leaflet 颜色函数实现。 机器注记:terra 1.9.27 的 global(x, "isnotNA") 报 “could not find function fun”,统计须传匿名函数;expect_message() 返回消息对象本身, 要拿表达式值须 expect_message(v <- ...)。

Release checklist

  1. devtools::document(), devtools::test() green.
  2. R CMD check on a fresh tarball: 0 errors / 0 warnings.
  3. pkgdown::build_site() refreshed and docs/ updated.
  4. Bump Version in DESCRIPTION (maintainer decides; suggest usethis::use_version).
  5. Maintainer commits, tags (vX.Y.Z) and pushes personally.
